ability.name: Corrupted Earth
ability.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Pestilens^^** units that are in combat to be the targets.
